editorial.blurb: A beloved Chicago taqueria where housemade salsas with kick and expertly-cooked specialty meats like cabeza, tripa, and lengua keep locals and visitors coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Park in the back behind the building—never on the side by the laundromat or you'll get towed. Order tripa medium-cooked and menudo with bones for the most flavorful broth.

topDishes.note: Hard to find done well; this version is delicious and tender
Huge portions and deeply flavorful broth, especially with bones
Unique preparation without tomatillo; juicy and flavorful
